name: Thorn Hopper
telegraph: The throat nozzle and thorn pods advertise the seed attack; pauses before the two aimed shots.
counterplay: Keep moving through the second shot; each burst shot re-aims.
projectile: Barbed seed dart. Uses ordinary hit damage; no new poison system.
notes: Live stats and loot are defined in scripts/enemies/enemies.gd; staged design values are authoring references.
